name: SISO Agent Base Source Warehouse
summary: The retired mixed-source repository from which SISO Runtime, capabilities, intelligence, integrations, and research Works are being read, preserved, and reallocated.

relationships.context: The clean SISO Agent Runtime is one extracted successor boundary; the warehouse remains a preserved source record, not its runtime dependency.

evidence.summary: The application boundary and surrounding mixed warehouse were read and classified separately.

The repository contains one shippable application boundary plus independent products, packages, experiments, state, data, imports, archives, and nested repositories; it is therefore registered as a retired source warehouse rather than an agent framework.
A read-only partial inventory preserves module paths, dispositions, target Works, evidence, and unresolved comparisons without moving the dirty source checkout.
Public source warehouse pin resolves; it is preserved as extraction provenance rather than modeled as one application.

license.reason: The pinned public source warehouse reports and contains an MIT license.

evidence.summary: Public repository visibility and MIT license were verified during the source audit.

addressable.reason: The preserved warehouse is pinned to an exact public commit.

archive_downloadable.reason: A commit-scoped public preservation archive is recorded.

manifest_resolvable.reason: The preservation release resolves to the dedicated source-warehouse Work.

installable.reason: A retired mixed-source warehouse is preserved for provenance and extraction, not distributed as one installable product.

forkable.reason: The preserved source pin is public and MIT licensed, with its mixed status and limitations documented.

portable.reason: Portability is assessed for the extracted Works; the retired warehouse is a preservation and provenance container.
